summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Smart Lending App (Lendify). 15/15 backend pytest tests pass (auth, dashboard, applications, AI scoring via Claude, approve/reject/fund, loans, repayments, transactions, notifications). Full frontend lender workflow verified on mobile viewport: register → dashboard → requests → AI-scored detail → fund → loans → mark paid → alerts → profile → logout all functional with correct testIDs.

minor.issue: chart_disbursed month labels duplicate 'Jan' and skip 'Feb' (labels observed: Nov, Dec, Jan, Jan, Mar, Apr). Caused by naive 30-day delta arithmetic in server.py ~line 599. Use relativedelta or subtract calendar months instead.

ui_bugs.issue: Duplicate 'Jan' x-axis label (backend issue surfaces in UI)

issues: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow); props.pointerEvents deprecated. Non-blocking but should migrate in Shadows theme constants.

action_items: Fix dashboard chart_disbursed month computation in server.py so labels show 6 consecutive months without duplicates (use calendar month decrement).
(Optional) Migrate Shadows theme from shadow* props to boxShadow to silence deprecation warnings on web.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 695 lines — acceptable but approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting auth / applications / loans into routers.
MongoDB _id is properly excluded everywhere via projection {'_id': 0}.
AI scoring has a deterministic fallback (_fallback_score) if emergentintegrations/LLM fails — good resilience.
EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL used in frontend/src/api.ts (no hardcoded URLs). Good.
All interactive elements have testIDs (tab-login, tab-signup, input-*, submit-auth, google-signin, fund-btn, approve-btn, reject-btn, pay-month-N, logout-btn, mark-all-read, etc.).
seed_data_creation: Cleared and re-seeded MongoDB collections (applications, loans, transactions, notifications) once during testing to reset the 10 seeded pending applications. Backend seed_demo_data re-ran on restart. Created test users qa_*, qa2_*, qa3_*, qae2e_*, qaff_* @lendify.app. Demo user demo@lendify.app / Demo123! verified working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend exposes all endpoints at /api prefix. Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. TestIDs on frontend follow mixed conventions: fund-btn/approve-btn/reject-btn (hyphen suffix), app-item-{id}, loan-item-{id}, pay-month-{n}, mark-all-read, logout-btn, stat-*, filter-*. 10 applications are seeded on startup only if collection is empty — to re-seed, drop db.applications and restart backend. AI scoring first call takes 5-15s per application (Claude sonnet 4.5 via emergentintegrations).
rca_of_issue: Chart duplicate-month bug: server.py uses `(now.replace(day=1) - timedelta(days=30*i)).replace(day=1)` which drifts because months aren't 30 days. For i=3 this may land in the same month as i=2 in mid-year. Fix: decrement month index and roll year when month<1. No other issues found.
